reason: I'd try the free 10-DM preview because typing openers by hand is wrecking me, but $147 a month is a big chunk of what I make when client work is thin, and other DM tools cost a third of that. I'm not putting a card down for something with no customer results yet.
objection: $147 a month is three or four times what other Instagram DM tools charge, and nobody has shown it actually books calls. The guarantee needs 300 sent DMs and a booked call, so with my busy weeks I could easily miss it and be stuck paying.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $79 to $99 a month, or real results from a founding member who is an agency owner at my size, showing booked calls from the first month.
